Name: Stack Buffs
Author: namelessto
Description:
[center][size=7][b]Stack Buffs[/b][/size]
[i]Eat again without losing your buff, get a blessing from every statue you've placed, and stop fussing with blessing menus.[/i][/center]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Vanilla Stardew replaces an active buff the moment you eat or drink the same type again, and caps statue blessings at one per day no matter how many you've placed. This mod fixes both, and adds auto-pick and extended ore node support for the Statue of the Dwarf King.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Three buff stacking modes: Additive, Independent, and Refresh And Stack.[/*]
[*]Each statue gets its own daily blessing: two statues means two blessings.[/*]
[*]Extended ore node support for the Statue of the Dwarf King: Calico Egg Nodes, Gem Nodes, and Mussel Nodes.[/*]
[*]Auto-pick for the Statue of the Dwarf King: skips the menu and chooses based on a priority list you configure.[/*]
[*]Randomize Daily Offering option re-rolls the Statue of the Dwarf King's offered blessings each day.[/*]
[*]Works with food, drinks, and desert festival questionnaire buffs.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[b]Buff stacking[/b]: enable in config and eat or drink as normal. The stacking mode determines what happens when you consume the same food while a buff is already active:
[list]
[*][b]Additive[/b] (default): adds the full duration on top of your remaining time.[/*]
[*][b]Independent[/b]: each application gets its own timer running in parallel.[/*]
[*][b]Refresh And Stack[/b]: resets the timer to full and adds another effect layer.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Statue stacking[/b]: enable [b]One per statue[/b] in config, then place multiple Blessing Statues or Statues of the Dwarf King. Each statue gives its own daily blessing independently.

A couple of blessings won't stack by design: infinite energy (Blessing Statue) and bomb immunity (Statue of the Dwarf King) won't be offered again if already active, since a second stack would do nothing.

[b]Statue of the Dwarf King auto-pick[/b]: enable [b]Auto-Pick[/b] in config. Assign each of the five blessings a priority from 1 to 5. When two are offered, the lower-ranked one is chosen automatically.

[b]Default ranking:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]+1 Ore from Nodes[/*]
[*]Ladders & Shafts[/*]
[*]Coal Find Chance[/*]
[*]Bomb Immunity[/*]
[*]Geode Find Chance[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

All options are in [b]config.json[/b] or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game.

[list]
[*][b]Stacking Mode[/b]: Additive, Independent, or Refresh And Stack. (default: Additive)[/*]
[*][b]One per statue[/b]: track daily blessings per statue instead of per type. (default: on)[/*]
[*][b]Calico Egg Nodes[/b]: include Calico Egg Nodes in the ore bonus. (default: on)[/*]
[*][b]Gem Nodes[/b]: include gem nodes in the ore bonus. (default: on)[/*]
[*][b]Mussel Nodes[/b]: include Mussel Nodes in the ore bonus. (default: on)[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Pick[/b]: skip the blessing menu and choose by priority. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Blessing priorities[/b]: rank each of the five blessings from 1 to 5.[/*]
[*][b]Randomize Daily Offering[/b]: re-roll offered blessings on first interaction each day. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.2.1 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [i](optional, for in-game config)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

You can drop it into an existing save without any issues. It only changes how buffs are applied and how statue blessing selection works, so it won't conflict with most other mods.
